forum.title: STM32CubeMX do not have the Register CallBacl setting of GPU2D. How to setup?

forum.content_text:
I use  GPU2D on STM32U599Z .

On CubeMX,

I  checked Activate check box  GPU2D  at "Pinout & Configuration".

and  I saw " Project Manager > Advanced Settings"

There is not GPU2D In Register Callback Groupe.

![shingo_0-1775708962667.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/61801065-3186-377b-306f-a9b4bc03adcf.png "shingo_0-1775708962667.png")

However , The Generated code stm32u5xx\_hal\_conf.h have  "

```

#define USE_HAL_GPU2D_REGISTER_CALLBACKS 0U /* GPU2D register callback disabled */

```

![shingo_1-1775709242498.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/eac9dada-9625-da99-7e96-5c258aa8e910.png "shingo_1-1775709242498.png")

How to set this setting?
